# Native voice fixtures

These six mono48kHz Ogg/Opus files contain synthetic400Hz PCM, generated by the original Telegram native encoder with the VYRN end-of-stream fix. No microphone or user recording was used.

`media-voice-codec` writes50 frames of960 samples, then a final input of0,480 or959 samples. The resulting durations are1000,1010 and1020ms (rounded upwards). The `decoded` files are produced by the original native `cropOpusFile` decoding the whole recording and encoding it again; duration must remain unchanged.

Generated on the dedicated Android35 x86_64 emulator using local TLS APK SHA-256 d1f2eeb6bbd40f5c62e67c9e576cb99e80680cdb871e0fe014d9f39bb74ff463. Upstream pin: f2908b14133bbffbf7ab04f641ecb5bfaf533242. Use the instrumentation phase and extract only `files/vyrn-native-voice-{tail}.ogg` and `files/vyrn-native-voice-decoded-{tail}.ogg` from the test app to regenerate.
